nursery_days.quote: the seedlings are transplanted after four weeks

days_to_first_harvest.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, flower crops
days_to_first_harvest.quote: Flowers are picked once in 3 days beginning from 60 days after planting.

harvest_span_days.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, flower crops
harvest_span_days.quote: The crop duration is about 130 - 150 days.

sun.title: NC State Extension Plant Toolbox
sun.quote: Light: Full sun (6 or more hours of direct sunlight a day) Partial Shade (Direct sunlight only part of the day, 2-6 hours)

water_need.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, flower crops
water_need.quote: Irrigation is done once in a week or as and when necessary.
water_need.note: Interpreted: watering every 7-10 days or less once established is 'low', every few days 'medium'; no source uses the low/medium/high scale. Agronomist to confirm.

expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, flower crops
expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.quote: The average yield is about 18 t/ha.

source_notes: AI research batch 4 (2026-10-05). Ranges are stored at their lower bound; the source range is in each quote. Batch 4 (trees, border and flowers). Planting windows are the source's months (Tamil Nadu or Kerala) until a Malwa source is found.
